in_marathi.name: Nimish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Day, Moment, Instant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, 'Nimish' is derived from the root word 'Nim', which means 'day', 'time', or 'moment'. This name is often used to represent the fleeting nature of life, emphasizing the importance of living in the present. In Hindu mythology, Nimish is also the name of the god of time, presiding over the cycles of day and night.
